policy: Every acquisition-proven item is mapped to all applicable profession pools or shared delivery pools available to all twelve decrees, unless explicitly excluded for creative/admin, disabled content, station/container/NBT, unique progression, a runtime-confirmed BlockItem/EntityBlock safety veto, or the 2500-item shared supply cap. The cap uses deterministic namespace round-robin selection. Item models are acquisition-audit candidates, never obtainability proofs. Loot requires placement/living-class evidence; complete spawn/config/world reachability and procedural-only acquisition are not claimed. Native registry/block-entity checks still apply.
runtime_safety: Runtime-confirmed BlockItem/EntityBlock vetoes are excluded before pool generation. Native PoolEntry.isValid remains a defensive veto on every roll/reload. KubeJS verifies registrations and reports any typed runtime exclusions. Unrelated native/addon bounty entries are unchanged.
